meta.name: game-sprint-plan
meta.description: Invoke when the user needs to plan a development sprint, break down tasks, schedule game work, or organize a sprint with cross-discipline dependencies. Triggers on: "sprint plan", "task breakdown", "development planning", "scheduling", "sprint backlog". Do NOT invoke for scope evaluation (use game-scope-check) or retrospectives (use game-retrospective). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划开发冲刺并分解任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要组织跨职能团队的游戏开发冲刺。
copy.tagline_en: Plan development sprints and break down tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to organize game development sprints with cross-discipline dependencies.

howto.what: 这个技能会引导你制定游戏开发冲刺计划。它会帮你设定一个明确的冲刺目标，把任务拆解成一天以内的小任务，标记依赖关系，并按优先级分层（必须/应该/可以/不做），最后计算团队实际产能并预留20%缓冲。
howto.when: 当你需要规划一个开发冲刺、拆解任务、安排日程，或者组织涉及跨工种依赖的冲刺时触发。例如你说“冲刺计划”、“任务拆解”等关键词。

say.text: 帮我规划下一个游戏开发冲刺，目标是实现核心战斗循环。
say.note: 技能会引导你定义目标、拆解任务并计算产能。

say.text: 为我的独立游戏安排接下来两周的工作，重点是敌人AI。
say.note: 技能会生成包含依赖关系和优先级分层的冲刺计划。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you in creating a game development sprint plan. It helps define a clear sprint goal, breaks tasks into day-sized chunks, maps dependencies, tiers scope (Must/Should/Could/Won't), and calculates team capacity with a 20% buffer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to plan a development sprint, break down tasks, schedule work, or organize a sprint with cross-discipline dependencies. Keywords include "sprint plan", "task breakdown", etc.

say_en.text: Help me plan the next dev sprint with a goal of implementing the core combat loop.
Schedule the next two weeks for my indie game, focusing on enemy AI.
say_en.note: The skill will produce a sprint plan with dependencies and scope tiers.
